prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one isolated Blue Hermit grapple reference for image-to-3D. The input is the user's preferred design. Recreate ONLY the isolated accessory shown in the middle row of that exact board, as a single object centered on a clean white square. Enlarge the middle row's prop to fill roughly 86 percent of the width with generous margins. Keep its geometry and restrained ornament: aged dark warm bronze two-flange spool, concentric engraved rings and a small raised blue cabochon at its center, coiled flat woven ribbon between the flanges, slim stitched dark-brown leather mount backing with a small underside key. Short single flat ribbon goes straight right from the spool to a bronze swivel eye. One compact ornate anchor to the right with two sweeping crescent blades, one short central pointed nose, shaped stepped bronze shank, and a small rich blue cabochon in the center. Keep actual silhouette, sizes, darkened bevels, elegant shallow edge detailing and relative spacing of the reference. Show the broad face of crescent clearly. Keep spool's thickness and winding visible from a shallow elevated orthographic front angle.
Match ribbon to the outfit's DARK muted slate-indigo cloth shown in the board sleeves, about #2b344d in midtones; no bright royal blue. The ribbon is darkest indigo woven flat tape, with restrained fine antique-gold thread on a few subtle diagonals like the source. Deep blue inset stones can catch soft highlights. Natural aged warm bronze, dark grooves. Soft neutral studio light, plain uniform white background, horizontal composition spool left and hook right. No redesign, no simplification into a plain C, no large blue enamel disk, no hand, no bracer, no mount strap, no text, caption, borders, dividers, shadow, watermark or extra parts. Exactly one standalone accessory.
references: Chase's attached preferred Blue grapple design sheet
